faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about immigration and registration in Finland.

q1.question: How do I apply for a residence permit in Finland?
q1.answer: Residence permit applications are generally handled by the Finnish Immigration Service (Migri). You can find information about permit types, requirements, and application procedures on Migri's official website.

q2.question: What is a Finnish personal identity code?
q2.answer: A Finnish personal identity code is a unique identifier used in Finland's population information system. It is commonly needed when dealing with authorities and accessing various services.

q3.question: How do I register my address in Finland?
q3.answer: Address registration depends on your circumstances. You can find instructions through DVV and the official moving notification service. Registering an address and obtaining a municipality of residence are related but distinct matters.

q4.question: What is Suomi.fi?
q4.answer: Suomi.fi is a Finnish public service platform that provides information about government services and supports electronic identification and authorizations.

q5.question: Can international residents apply for a Finnish identity card?
q5.answer: Some foreign citizens residing in Finland may be eligible for an identity card issued by the Finnish Police. Eligibility depends on specific conditions, so check the official Police instructions.
